summary: The compliance review of the CarKey product, 'Used-Car Loans Through Dealers,' identified two findings against the reviewed RBI rules. A high-risk finding was noted under DLD2025:9(i) regarding the direct payment of the loan into the dealer's bank account, which may not align with the intended purpose of the loan.
